personality_one_liner: A trustworthy, balance-first financial companion with clean typography, calm natural tones, and generous spacing that makes tracking money feel effortless and controlled.

spacing.rule: Generous padding around content. Never flush to screen edges. Use md (12) gap for grids and lg (16) or xl (24) for screen padding. Handle spacing correctly without extra unnecessary margins.

do's: Featured/Hero cards over brand-tinted or abstract photo backdrop

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: Monthly summary and quick budget tracking at a glance.

states.empty: N/A - Dashboard always shows at least zero balances.
states.error: Readable message + Retry button taking full screen

screens.layout: Top balance hero card featuring `dashboard_hero` image, a gradient scrim (transparent to 70% surfaceInverse), and ending/starting balances overlaid in white. Below this, a horizontal scroll or tight vertical list of Budget Categories (planned vs actual) as progress cards. Floating Quick Add FAB (brandPrimary) above the tab bar.

screens.name: Transactions
screens.purpose: Log and review all incoming and outgoing money.

states.empty: Empty wallet illustration (`empty_wallet`), short sentence 'No transactions yet', and a primary 'Add Transaction' CTA.
states.error: Readable message + Retry button taking full screen

screens.layout: Sticky glassmorphism header over a segmented control for Income vs Expenses. Below, a list of transactions grouped by date. Each row has a brandTertiary tinted rounded icon square, transaction title, and amount.

screens.name: Accounts
screens.purpose: Track balances across multiple financial accounts over time.

states.empty: Empty state illustration + 'No accounts added' + 'Add Account' CTA.
states.error: Readable message + Retry button taking full screen

screens.layout: Net worth summary at the top. A vertical list of accounts categorized by type (Registered, Crypto, Cash). Each account card is width 100% displaying account name, balance, and change over time.

screens.name: Investments
screens.purpose: Visualize investment allocation according to percentage rules.

states.error: Readable message + Retry button taking full screen

screens.layout: Donut chart visualizing current vs planned allocation (EF 5%, Grow 15%, FHSA 30%, etc.). Below the chart, a list of investment buckets with target monetary amounts derived from current income and their respective percentages.

dashboard_hero.alt: Abstract watercolor sage green wavy pattern for hero background

empty_wallet.alt: Floating brown leather wallet minimalist illustration

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette. Blue, indigo, and purple are BANNED. The app uses warm sand (F9F9F7) and sage green (4B6955).
Use Space Grotesk for prominent numbers (balances, amounts) to give a slight technical/financial feel while using Plus Jakarta Sans for the rest of the text.
Do NOT use font weights above 500 anywhere in the app. Use font size to establish hierarchy instead of bold weights.

The Dashboard hero card MUST use the `dashboard_hero` image layered with an expo-linear-gradient scrim (transparent at 0% to 70% surfaceInverse at 100%) so that the balance text is fully readable over it.
Implement a 'Quick Add' FAB for transactions. It should sit above the tab bar, anchored to the bottom right, and use `brandPrimary` with glassmorphism.
Cards should fill the horizontal space using single column `width: '100%'` with `lg` screen padding (no half-width-on-the-left orphans).
Avoid emoji everywhere in the app. Use Ionicons.
Use @expo/vector-icons (Ionicons). Every screen should have consistent icon styles (e.g., all outlined except for active tab bar icons).
